1. **Consult with Healthcare Providers**: Before starting any new treatment, discuss your interest in herbal remedies with your dermatologist or healthcare provider. They may have valuable insights and can help you understand if certain herbs might interact negatively with your medications.

2. **Research Thoroughly**: Do thorough research about the herbs you’re considering. Look for scientific studies that investigate their effects on psoriasis. Reliable sources such as medical journals or reputable health organizations’ websites can provide solid information. Be wary of anecdotal evidence or overly promotional content online.

Keep an eye on whether your condition changes—both positively and negatively—as you use these new additions to your routine. Adjusting gradually like this will make it easier to tell which aspects of your regimen might actually be having an impact.
